title: Satellite mistaken for object near Jupiter on X

tellings.quote: And so on X, this happened like a year ago. On X, I see people going, "Oh my god, there's a weird thing going around Jupiter or Saturn." It's like, no, it's going around the Earth.

plain: About a year before the conversation, people on the social media site X got excited about a strange object they thought was circling Jupiter or Saturn, when it was really a satellite going around the Earth. That is how Michael Shermer, a well-known skeptic who studies why people believe unusual things, tells it from what he saw posted, as an example of how easily ordinary objects in the sky get mistaken for something extraordinary.
